svg.title: Exact within-query cancellation across six attribute-order comparisons at Top-20.
svg.desc: A six-row table lists dataset, encoder, eligible queries, and the Top-20 proportion of queries with equal positive gains and losses. WANDS ranges are MiniLM 16.88-21.75, BGE 21.75-25.32, and GTE 19.81-26.30 percent, with denominator 308. ESCI ranges are MiniLM 1.40-2.81, BGE 2.40-3.21, and GTE 3.01-4.21 percent, with denominator 499. Ranges span six existing comparisons and are not confidence intervals.
